FN-9JA9HBB-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 234
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Alan Baker
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/18/2025
REVISED
House Bill 234 as introduced will increase the obligations of certain local boards of education
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to implement the mobile emergency rapid
response system by October 1, 2030, pursuant to the provisions of this bill. These increased
obligations may be offset, in whole or in part, by allowing the boards to use certain state funds
to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill will increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education to develop a list of approved vendors and to adopt rules to administer the provisions
of this bill.
This bill would have an estimated aggregate fiscal impact of greater than $50,000 annually on
affected local government entities and is subject to the provisions of Section 111.05 of the
Constitution of Alabama of 2022.

FN-9JA9HBB-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 234
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Alan Baker
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 234 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
governing bodies of local boards of education and public charter schools to purchase mobile
emergency rapid response systems and equip and train designated personnel by October 1, 2030,
subject to annual dedicated school safety funds. This bill would allow the governing bodies to
use certain state funds to comply with the provisions of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education to develop a list of approved vendors providing mobile approved emergency rapid
response systems and to adopt rules to administer the provisions of this bill.
